title_en: A young man rose early on Sunday
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: WWII partisan song, no author named. 'лудо' in line 1 is my reading as 'young man' (literally 'crazy/young one'). Karaorman is a mountain and Debarca a region near Ohrid.

lines.en: A young man rose early on Sunday,

lines.cyr: партизан д' оди в' гора зелена.
lines.lat: partizan d' odi v' gora zelena.
lines.en: a partisan goes to the green forest.

lines.cyr: Штом се искачи горе над село,
lines.lat: Štom se iskači gore nad selo,
lines.en: As soon as he climbed up above the village,

lines.cyr: Цела Дебарца в' пламен се крена,
lines.lat: Cela Debarca v' plamen se krena,
lines.en: Whole Debarca rose up in flame,
they burned down the whole village.
The whole village, the village of Slivovo,
- Come on, brothers, let us fight,

lines.cyr: сите д' изгинеме, не се жалиме!
lines.lat: site d' izgineme, ne se žalime!
lines.en: let us all fall, we do not regret it!
